fixes.explanation: Flip that one around, friend, because it's TRUE. This time the song gives the reason: give thanks to the LORD because He is good and His loving devotion endures forever (1 Chronicles 16:34). Back in verse 8 it just said to give thanks (1 Chronicles 16:8). I once stared at a finished batch for ten minutes asking myself if it was done, and the whole time my timer was going off.

Ha, big dreams, friend! But that isn't in this cry. The people ask to be saved so that, in the song's words, “…that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.” (1 Chronicles 16:35) Thanks is the whole point there, not a crown. I can barely run my own counter, and it's only one counter.
